newsitem.title: USA: Cramer group lifts Penril stake.
newsitem.headline: Cramer group lifts Penril stake.

text.p: A group led by New York investor James Cramer said Friday it raised its stake in Penril DataComm Networks Inc to 1,234,050 common shares or 11.7 percent from 10.1 percent previously held.

In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the group said its latest transactions include a net of 173,400 common shares bought between August 30 and October 16 at prices ranging from $12.75 to $14.625 per share.
The group holds the stake in Penril for investment purposes.
